title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (1017)
notes: 24-hour autonomous run on DeepSeek Harness (95 commits, 3,515 tool calls, 1.16B total tokens / 1.15B cached). Re-graded on v3.1, its best 100%-valid 25-route checkpoint (b4c0cd1, 4.0 h) scores 1.566x (36.1% console frame time saved, 1.166x vs GCC -O2) and passes PLAY=1 boot smoke, including hand-tuned lib/rsp.s I-cache padding and aligned CACHE 0x0d in bzero. Later commits hit 1.986x on public courses while introducing unaligned CACHE 0x0d / .bss main_pool pressure on HMC/LLL, 6,500-unit actor hibernation breaking SSL/WDW, and KSEG1 dirty-cache synonyms.
